name: anki
description: Anki is a smart spaced repetition flashcard program
one_liner: A flashcard app that shows you each card right before you're about to forget it, so studying anything (a language, medical terms, exam material) takes far less time to actually stick.
buyer: A medical or nursing student who has thousands of facts to memorize for board exams and needs the most efficient possible study method.
business_use_cases: A tutoring business sells pre-made, subject-specific flashcard decks (bar exam law, USMLE medicine, language vocabulary) as a paid product bundled with tutoring.
A corporate training company builds spaced-repetition decks for compliance or product-knowledge certification, cutting re-training time.
A language-learning coach offers a 'done-for-you deck' service, building custom vocabulary decks from a client's own reading material.

money_ideas.idea: Sell curated, subject-specific flashcard deck packs for high-stakes exams
Offer a custom-deck-building service where clients send material and get back a ready-to-study deck

steal_this: This weekend, build and sell one polished, well-sourced deck for a specific certification exam that currently has no good free deck available.
